decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n (i / nb) % P.\n// This keeps the trailing-matrix update - the dominant O(n^3) cost - load\n// balanced across ranks even as the active submatrix shrinks.\n\n// Unblocked sequential Cholesky, used locally to factor each small diagonal\n// block (nb x nb) owned by a single rank.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Row -> owning rank under 1D block-cyclic distribution with block size nb.\nstatic inline int ownerOfRow(size_t row, size_t nb, int P) {\n    return static_cast<int>((row / nb) % static_cast<size_t>(P));\n}\n\n// Global row indices (ascending) owned by a given rank.\nstatic std::vector<size_t> rowsOwnedByRank(size_t n, size_t nb, int P, int rank) {\n    std::vector<size_t> rows;\n    rows.reserve(n / static_cast<size_t>(P) + nb);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        if generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA, const size_t n,\n                                     const std::vector<size_t>& localRows) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    const size_t nLocal = localRows.size();\n    localA.assign(nLocal * n, 0.0);\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocal; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = localRows[li];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n }\n}\n\n// Gather a row-distributed matrix into a full n x n matrix on `root`.\nstatic void gatherFullMatrix(const std::vector<double>& localA, std::vector<double>& fullA,\n const size_t startIdx = static_cast<size_t>(startIt - localRows.begin());\n        const size_t nLocal = localRows.size();\n\n        for (size_t li = startIdx; li < nLocal; ++li) {\n            const * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; rowsOwnedByRank(size_t n, size_t nb, int P, int rank) {\n    std::vector<size_t> rows;\n    rows.reserve(n / static_cast<size_t>(P) + nb);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        if generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA, const size_t n,\n                                     const std::vector<size_t>& localRows) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Row -> owning rank under 1D block-cyclic distribution with block size nb.\nstatic inline int rowsOwnedByRank(size_t n, size_t nb, int P, int rank) {\n    std::vector<size_t> rows;\n    rows.reserve(n / static_cast<size_t>(P) + nb);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        if generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& localA, const size_t n,\n                                     const std::vector<size_t>& localRows) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    const size_t nLocal = localRows.size();\n    localA.assign(nLocal * n, 0.0);\n\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nLocal; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = localRows[li];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n }\n}\n\n// Gather a row-distributed matrix into a full n x n matrix on `root`.\nstatic void gatherFullMatrix(const std::vector<double>& localA, std::vector<double>& fullA,\n std::vector<double> gatherBuf;\n    if (rank == root) {\n        gatherBuf.resize(static_cast<size_t>(total));\n    }\n\n    MPI_Gatherv(localA.data(), static_cast<int>(localA.size()), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                rank == root ? gatherBuf.data() : nullptr, recvcounts.data(), displs.data(),\n                MPI_DOUBLE, root, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (rank == root) {\n        fullA.assign(n * n, decomposition.\n// localA holds, for each rank, the full-width (n columns) rows it owns,\n// in ascending global-row order, matching `localRows`.\nbool choleskyDecompositionMPI(std::vector<double>& localA, size_t n, size_t nb,\n                               const std::vector<size_t>& localRows,\n                               const std::vector<long long>& localIndexOf, int rank, int P) {\n    const size_t nblk = (n + nb - 1) / nb;\n\n    // Precompute the full row ownership map once (needed to build the\n    // Allgatherv layout for the panel broadcast at every step).\n    std::vector<std::vector<size_t>> allRows(P);\n    for (int r = 0; r < P; ++r) {\n        allRows[r] = rowsOwnedByRank(n, nb, P, r);\n    }\n\n    for (size_t kb = 0; kb < nblk; ++kb) {\n        const size_t k0 = kb * nb;\n        const size_t k1 = std::min(k0 + nb, n);\n        const size_t kbs = k1 - k0;\n        const int ownerK = static_cast<int>(kb % static_cast<size_t>(P));\n\n        // 1) Factor the diagonal block (kbs x kbs) on its owner rank.\n        std::vector<double> diagBlock(kbs * kbs);\n        int successFlag = 1;\n        if (rank == ownerK) {\n            for (size_t r = 0; }\n\n        if (k1 >= n) {\n            continue; // no trailing submatrix left\n        }\n\n        // 3) Gather the freshly computed panel (rows [k1, n), cols [k0, k1))\n        // from all ranks {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011Cf2YmT1PfBZSsA4bmZ991","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Only `cholesky.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` were modified, as required (`output.txt` is an unrelated pre-existing session log).\n\n## Summary\n\nI parallelized the Cholesky benchmark with MPI using a **right-looking blocked algorithm with 1D block-cyclic row distribution**:\n\n- Rows are distributed as `owner(row) = (row / nb) % P`, so each rank stores only its own rows (reducing per-node memory by ~1/P), with cyclic assignment keeping load balanced as the trailing submatrix shrinks.\n- Per block-column step: the owning rank factors the small diagonal block (reusing the original unblocked routine), broadcasts it; every rank does the panel triangular solve for its own rows; panel data is exchanged via a single `MPI_Allgatherv`; then each rank updates only the trailing rows it owns — the dominant O(n³) work is fully parallel.\n- Matrix generation is also distributed (each rank builds only its owned rows), and results are gathered back to rank 0 only when needed (`-v`/`-r`), matching the original CLI/output semantics.\n- `CMakeLists.txt` now requires MPI (`find_package(MPI REQUIRED)`, links `MPI::MPI_CXX`);
